security.csp: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' blob:; frame-src blob:; connect-src 'self' https: wss: http://127.0.0.1:* ws://127.0.0.1:* ipc: http://ipc.localhost; manifest-src 'self'; worker-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; form-action 'self'; base-uri 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: The ADE on your own machine
bundle.longDescription: Proofpane Community runs coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, Grok Build, OpenCode, Kimi Code, MiniMax Code) side by side on your own machine, each in a git worktree of its own, behind the workspace's gate, and signs a manifest for each change it checks.
